record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Four units declare IRON_DEFENSE: Shieldon (1 star), Clamperl (1 star, passive BIVALVE), Bastiodon (2 stars) and Stakataka (3 stars, passive WALL_OF_STONE). The strategy is shared; differences are the star index, maxPP and the passives, which were not traced here.
record.summary: The caster gives a shield to every unit of its own team that stands in the caster's row (same positionY), the caster itself included. The requested amount is 20/40/80/160 by the caster's star count; each recipient's applied amount is that value after Big Eater Belt (holder), AP scaling (caster AP, apBoost 1), the cast's crit multiplier (only if the cast crit), halving if the recipient is enraged, and rounding.

targeting.who: the caster and all allied units on the caster's row, evaluated when the cast resolves
targeting.note: The cast target is passed to the base process (animation) but is not used for the shield; the loop uses only the caster's team and positionY. Allies elsewhere on the board are not shielded.

geometry.shape: one board row (all columns with y equal to the caster's positionY)

effects.target: every ally (same team, caster included) with y equal to the caster's positionY
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]; recipient Big Eater Belt: positive value x 1.25 rounded down; then state.addShield with apBoost 1: x (1 + caster AP/100); x caster critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT since canCritByDefault is false); x 0.5 if the recipient is enraged; Math.round
effects.resolution: applied = rounded result added to the recipient's shield (floor 0, only if recipient hp > 0); the caster's shieldDone counts the applied amount. Shield absorbing later damage is resolved in handleDamage and not traced here.

starBehavior.note: Table indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star entry (160) is also the fallback. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Only allies whose positionY equals the caster's positionY receive the shield; the caster's own cell is included. Dead or absent cells are skipped (ally must exist); addShield does nothing if hp is 0.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Single mode. Each cast adds to existing shield values (pokemon.shield + shield); no cap seen in the cited lines.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): 20 (Shieldon, Clamperl), 40 (Bastiodon), 80 (Stakataka). Applied: requested after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged halving and rounding, per recipient. Absorbed damage is a separate step in handleDamage (not traced).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: How shield damage absorption is resolved in handleDamage (shield taken before hp, takenDamage amounts) was not traced for this record; see knowledge core-mechanics §A
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, canCast) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
